understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a spike, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction and landing previews indicate which move leads to useful passages. CLICK with a target position removes clickable breakable blocks without moving the player or advancing the rising-platform timer, allowing blocked gravity paths to open. Landing on spikes ends the attempt; each level allows two attempts with a turn limit. UNDO reverts the previous action and can recover from a mistaken move or click.
